notes: FASER search for a->gamma gamma with 57.7 fb^-1 at sqrt(s)=13.6 TeV; 1 event observed vs 0.44+/-0.39 expected background. Primary result is on the ALP-W plane (gaWW vs ma): couplings 3e-5 to 5e-4 GeV^-1 excluded for masses 100-250 MeV, and masses up to 300 MeV excluded at gaWW=2e-5 GeV^-1. Data points are approximate boundary values from the text (no numeric table; exclusion contours are in Fig. 10). The first three points trace the lower edge of the excluded region, the last two the upper edge. Coupling type is not a perfect enum match: the primary coupling is to W bosons, not photons; the paper also gives ALP-photon (g_agamma, masses up to 80 MeV, couplings down to 1e-4 GeV^-1), ALP-gluon, U(1)_B, up-philic scalar, 2HDM, and a dark photon reinterpretation (Fig. 14). Confidence reduced due to multiple coupling interpretations and text-only approximate data. No DM density assumption (collider LLP search, not a haloscope).
